brief:
Jerusalem Electricity Company announced planned power outages affecting multiple regions in the occupied West Bank, the Ma'an wire agency reported. The company said it will cut electricity from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. on unspecified dates across areas in Bethlehem governorate. The announcement did not clarify the reason for the scheduled cuts.

The power cuts are set to impact several neighborhoods in Bethlehem, though the company's notice did not provide a complete breakdown of which specific areas will experience outages or on which days the cuts will occur. Residents in affected areas were advised to prepare for the disruption to electrical service.
title: Jerusalem electricity company cuts power across West Bank areas
